How Wicked connects

  • Location: Gershwin Theatre — Wicked has played the Gershwin Theatre since 2003.
  • Topic: Broadway — Wicked is a long-running Broadway musical at the Gershwin.

What is Wicked?

Wicked is the musical about Elphaba and Glinda that opened at the Gershwin Theatre in 2003 and became the twenty-first century's other immovable Broadway booking beside Hamilton and The Lion King.

Key threads lead to Gershwin Theatre and Broadway.
